channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre: artigo de projeto da dosimetria entra em choque com dispositivo da Lei Antifacçăo
item.description: The president of the Brazilian National Congress, Davi Alcolumbre (Uniăo-AP), stated that a section of the Dosimetry bill conflicts with provisions of the recently approved Anti-Facçăo Law. His comment was made during the session on President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's veto of the bill.

item.title: TSE cassa o atual e torna inelegível ex-governador de RR por fraude em 2022
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) annulled the mandate of the current governor of Roraima, Edilson Damião (União), and declared former governor Antonio Denarium (Republicanos) ineligible for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. The ruling confirms electoral fraud occurred in the state election, undermining the legitimacy of the results.

item.title: Ex-bolsonarista e hoje lulista, Soraya lamenta derrota de Messias
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) expressed disappointment over the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, which failed with 34 votes in favor and 42 against in the Senate plenary. Elected in 2018 with Bolsonaro's support, Soraya broke with the former president and began voting with the government in 2024, officially joining the PSB in April 2026 to align with PT allies in Mato Grosso do Sul. During the hearing, she publicly urged Messias not to forget his friends if appointed to the Court.

item.title: Congresso aposta em nova derrota de Lula e já crava derrubada do PL da Dosimetria
item.description: The National Congress is expected to overturn the presidential veto on the Dosimetry Bill this Thursday, following the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, increasing political pressure on the Lula government. The bill would reduce sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, whose 27-year-and-three-month sentence could be lowered. Government allies acknowledge the anticipated defeat, while the opposition celebrates the setback as a sign of Planalto's fragility.

item.title: Complô contra Messias expõe o cálculo de Alcolumbre para 2027; entenda
item.description: The defeat of Jorge Messias in the STF sabatina was the result of a behind-the-scenes effort led by Davi Alcolumbre, who, despite publicly claiming neutrality, worked to build a majority against Lula’s nominee. The move reflects growing tension between Alcolumbre and the Planalto, with the senator assessing electoral implications for 2026 and the future composition of Congress, aiming to shape inter-branch relations and secure his own position in the Senate.

item.title: PT se antecipa a possível nova derrota e deve judicializar derrubada do veto ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: The PT is preparing to challenge a potential congressional override of President Lula’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill before the STF, arguing that Congress’s partial excision of the vetoed provision is procedurally irregular. The party contends that splitting the veto to exclude a section already approved in the Anti-Faction Law undermines constitutional procedure. The move aims to prevent beneficiaries of the bill — including those involved in the January 8 attacks and perpetrators of heinous crimes — from gaining sentence reductions.

item.title: Em manobra, Alcolumbre exclui do PL da Dosimetria trecho vetado por Lula que contradiz Lei Antifacção
item.description: Congress President Senator Davi Alcolumbre excluded from the Dosimetria Bill the provision vetoed by Lula that would have facilitated semi-open regime progression for convicts of heinous crimes, femicide, and criminal factions, contradicting the Anti-Faction Law. The maneuver prevents the integral rejection of the veto from benefiting January 8 defendants and Bolsonaro allies, preserving the presidential veto only on the conflicting clause.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes cumprimenta Messias após derrota no Senado: ‘A história saberá fazer justiça à sua trajetória’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes congratulated Jorge Messias after the Senate blocked his nomination to the STF, stating that Messias’s career, marked by dignity and dedication to public service, will be fairly judged by history. Mendes affirmed that the Senate’s decision must be respected but reiterated his public support for Messias as qualified for the judiciary. He also noted his preference for Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) as Lula’s nominee.

item.title: Entenda rejeição de Messias para vaga no STF e o que acontece agora
item.description: President Lula's nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court was rejected by the Senate on Wednesday (29), marking a historic defeat for the PT government. The rejection followed opposition-led efforts and dissent from some allies who questioned Messias's independence and political alignment. Lula is now expected to submit a new nominee, under pressure to choose a figure with broader consensus and less partisan baggage.

item.title: TSE determina novas eleições para o governo de Roraima após cassação de governador
item.description: The TSE annulled the mandate of Governor Edilson Damião and declared former Governor Antonio Denarium ineligible for eight years, ordering new direct elections for Roraima's government. The ruling, passed by majority, followed convictions for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections. Supplementary elections will be held on one of the 2026 electoral calendar dates, without affecting the general election in October.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes diz que decisão do Senado sobre Messias 'deve ser respeitada', mas exalta jurista: 'Brasil ganha em tê-lo onde estiver'
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes stated that the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF must be respected as an exercise of sovereignty, but praised him as one of Brazil's greatest recent jurists, citing his dignity, integrity and public service. Mendes said Brazil benefits from having him wherever he serves and condemned the attacks on Messias's honor during the five-month confirmation process.

item.title: 'Derrota de Messias é vitória de Alexandre de Moraes', analisa Ana Flor em O Assunto; entenda divisão no STF
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Messias to the STF was a victory for Alexandre de Moraes, who opposed the nomination and preferred Rodrigo Pacheco. The episode highlights a division in the Supreme Court, with Moraes leading a majority against the group of André Mendonça, the rapporteur of the Master case, who had Messias as his main supporter.

item.title: Senado exerceu sua prerrogativa, mas a história fará justiça a Messias, diz Gilmar
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes stated that although the Senate exercised its constitutional prerogative in rejecting Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, history will do justice to the attorney general's trajectory. He emphasized that Messias maintained courage, dignity, and humility during five months of public scrutiny, despite attacks on his honor.

item.title: Soraya critica articulação do governo: “Não está funcionando”
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) criticized the Lula government’s articulation with Congress, stating it is not functioning after the Senate rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF. The vote resulted in 42 against and 34 in favor, falling short of the 41 required, marking the first presidential nomination rejection for the STF since 1894. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre supported the rejection, representing a political setback for Lula in an election year.

item.title: Estatais federais têm deficit recorde de R$ 4,4 bi no 1º trimestre
item.description: Brazilian federal state-owned enterprises recorded a record deficit of R$ 4.4 billion in the first quarter of 2026, a 151.2% increase compared to the same period in 2025, according to Central Bank data. The figure excludes financial institutions such as Banco do Brasil, Caixa, BNDES and Petrobras, which together posted a profit of R$ 137.2 billion in 2025. The Lula government criticizes the BC’s methodology, arguing it fails to reflect the true financial health of enterprises by omitting detailed accounting items like revenues, costs, assets and liabilities.

item.title: Derrota de Messias no Senado vira meme nas redes sociais
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, with 42 votes against and 34 in favor, falling short of the required 41. This marks the first rejection of a presidential STF nomination in 132 years, since 1894 under President Floriano Peixoto. Opposition groups to President Lula’s government shared memes on social media celebrating the outcome.

item.title: Lula é petista. Sorte do PT, azar do PT
item.description: Lula, affiliated with the Workers' Party (PT), faces a political paradox in 2026: his party identity is both an asset and a liability. While the PT benefits from his leadership and legacy, his direct association with the party also exposes the government to criticism over alleged managerial failures and polarization, making his re-election a matter of luck for some and misfortune for others.

item.title: ASSISTA: Congresso pode reduzir a pena de Bolsonaro e impor nova derrota ao governo Lula
item.description: Congress is set to vote on Thursday to override President Lula's veto of a bill that would reduce sentences for those convicted of coup-related acts, including Jair Bolsonaro. Overriding the veto requires 257 votes in the Chamber of Deputies and 41 in the Senate, thresholds the opposition appears poised to meet. This would mark the second defeat for Lula's government this week, following the Senate's historic rejection of Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court.

item.title: 'Governo acabou', 'golaço' e 'começo do fim': o que disseram os presidenciáveis sobre derrota histórica de Messias?
item.description: The Senate rejected Jorge Messias's nomination to the STF, which pre-candidates interpreted as a historic defeat for Lula's government. Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated by saying the government 'ended', while Ronaldo Caiado called Messias Lula's 'cabo de chicote'. Romeu Zema praised the decision as a 'golaço do Brasil' and a 'stop to the politicization' of the STF.

item.title: Mulher de Flávio publica vídeo de aniversário para o senador
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), posted a birthday video honoring her husband, who turns 45, highlighting his affectionate personality, family dedication, and dialogue skills. The video includes testimonials from Fernanda and the senator’s mother, Rogéria Bolsonaro, praising his concern for others and his role as a father and husband.

item.title: Lula não se pronuncia sobre rejeição de Messias e Haddad lamenta: 'Gosto amargo'
item.description: Former Finance Minister and São Paulo gubernatorial pre-candidate Fernando Haddad lamented the Senate's rejection of Messias, stating that the fight against corruption and organized crime lost an ally in the Supreme Court. He said there are no winners in this situation and described the outcome as having a 'bitter taste'. President Lula did not comment on the matter.

item.title: Flávio pauta projeto que reserva vagas de PMs e bombeiros para mulheres
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will ensure the vote on a bill that reserves at least 20% of vacancies in public competitions for military police and fire departments for women. The measure aims to increase women's participation in state security forces, responding to demands for greater diversity and representation. The proposal was confirmed on April 30, 2026.

item.title: Moraes faz jantar com Alcolumbre na véspera de derrota de Messias e Lula desconfia
item.description: A dinner between Justice Alexandre de Moraes and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre raised Lula's suspicions that they had formed an alliance to block Jorge Messias' appointment to the Supreme Court. The meeting took place the day before Messias' nomination was defeated, fueling beliefs of political collusion.

item.title: Congresso analisa hoje veto a PL da Dosimetria; veja o que diz a proposta
item.description: Brazil's Congress is reviewing today, starting at 10 a.m., President Lula's (PT) veto of a bill that would reduce sentences for those convicted in the coup plot, potentially benefiting former President Jair Bolsonaro (PL). Known as the Dosimetry Bill, the proposal seeks to change sentencing criteria for responsibility crimes, sparking debate over impunity and the rule of law.

item.title: Alcolumbre já não sente em Lula o aroma de poder que o excitava
item.description: Alcolumbre no longer feels the same sense of power in Lula that once excited him, after successfully orchestrating the blocking of Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Federal Court. Though he had promised this move would be a 'historic day,' the outcome revealed a shift in their political dynamic, with Alcolumbre sensing diminished influence over Lula. The episode highlights growing tensions within the government’s coalition.

item.title: Dívida bruta supera 80% do PIB e volta ao nível da pandemia
item.description: Brazil's gross debt surpassed 80% of GDP in March 2026, reaching 80.1% — the highest level since July 2021. The rise was driven mainly by nominal interest expenses, net debt issuance, and currency depreciation, partly offset by nominal GDP growth. Under President Lula, the debt-to-GDP ratio has increased by 8.7 percentage points since the start of his term.

item.title: Antipetista declarado, Caiado é aprovado por 77% dos lulistas e 75% da esquerda de Goiás
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former governor of Goiás and PSD presidential candidate, maintains high approval in his state, with 84% among Goian voters and over 75% even among left-wing voters, including 77% among Lula supporters and 75% among non-Lulist left. Despite being a declared anti-PT figure and aligning with Bolsonarism, his administration is positively rated across all ideological spectra, with 69% positive, 21% regular, and 5% negative evaluations.

item.title: 3º mandato de Lula terá o maior rombo fiscal médio da história
item.description: Lula's third term is projected to record the highest nominal deficit average in Brazilian history at -8.54% of GDP, surpassing the previous record of -8.48% under Dilma and Temer. Interest payments on public debt will also reach a record 7.64% of GDP, driven by the Selic rate's upward trajectory, which rose to 15% under Gabriel Galípolo after Roberto Campos Neto's departure from the Central Bank.

item.title: Eduardo reivindica efeito borboleta na rejeição de Messias
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro claimed credit for contributing to the rejection of Jorge Messias’s nomination to the STF, stating the victory was the result of many efforts and depended on the departure of Minister Luís Roberto Barroso. His brother, Flávio Bolsonaro, denied any influence in the maneuver. The episode unfolded amid Senate pressure on the Lula government’s nomination.

item.title: PL da Dosimetria: entenda como derrubada do veto de Lula pode reduzir a pena de Bolsonaro
item.description: Overturning Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill could reduce the time Jair Bolsonaro must serve in closed regime, allowing his transition to semi-open regime as early as January 2028. With sentence remission for study or work, Bolsonaro could serve only 2 years and 2 months in closed detention, despite his original 27-year-and-3-month sentence being reduced to 22 years and 1 month due to the absorption of the violent abolition of the democratic state penalty by the attempted coup charge.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala a VEJA sobre derrota histórica de Lula e Messias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will appear on VEJA+TV's Ponto de Vista to discuss the historic Senate rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court, the first such defeat in 132 years. The vote ended 42-34 against Lula's nominee following an eight-hour CCJ hearing marked by opposition questioning of Messias' AGU tenure and ideological stances, including his opposition to abortion. The government may face another setback today with the review of the veto on the Dosimetry Bill.

item.title: Imprensa internacional repercute rejeição de Messias para o STF e destaca 'derrota histórica' de Lula
item.description: International press highlighted the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias, Minister of the Attorney General's Office, as a 'historical defeat' for President Lula's government, marking the sixth Supreme Court nominee vetoed in Brazilian history and the first since 1894. The defeat was attributed to political maneuvering by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, who opposed Lula's nominee after his preferred candidate, Rodrigo Pacheco, was not selected. The outcome underscores Lula's governance challenges due to his party's minority in Congress and raises doubts about his political alliance-building capacity.

item.title: Metrópoles entrevista Haddad, pré-candidato ao governo de SP. Siga no YouTube
item.description: Former Finance Minister and São Paulo gubernatorial pre-candidate Fernando Haddad (PT) told Metrópoles that the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the STF left a 'bitter taste,' praising Messias as one of the country's 'most impeccable' figures for his role in dismantling corruption schemes such as Reag, Master, Refit, and INSS. Haddad acknowledged trailing in the polls, with Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) leading in all first and second-round scenarios according to the Genial/Quaest survey released on April 29.

item.title: Charge do JCaesar: 30 de abril
item.description: The JCaesar cartoon published on April 30, 2026, satirizes the Brazilian political scene, focusing on figures such as Jorge Messias, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the Senate, and the STF. The humor highlights institutional tensions and the role of powers in the current electoral context.

item.title: Derrota de Messias pode fazer aliados de Lula resgatarem ‘Congresso inimigo do povo’
item.description: Lula's allies are considering reviving the narrative that Congress is 'the enemy of the people' after senators rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, blaming Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for orchestrating the opposition. There are expectations of social media campaigns and possible street protests to pressure the legislature, though some advisors urge caution due to upcoming votes requiring Senate approval.

item.title: O que os discursos dizem sobre as estratégias de Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Zema, Caiado e Renan Santos
item.description: Lula combines the classic 'poor vs rich' narrative with a defense of democracy against external threats, reinforcing his image as a sovereignty protector. Flávio Bolsonaro positions himself as the moderate face of the right, avoiding internal conflicts and emphasizing fiscal responsibility and institutional dialogue. Ronaldo Caiado seeks to capitalize on Lula’s unpopularity by claiming to be the true heir of the right due to his long-standing opposition to the PT, while highlighting his administrative experience as a key differentiator from the Bolsonaros.

item.title: Messias cogitou pedir demissão da AGU após derrota no Senado
item.description: Minister Jorge Messias considered resigning from the AGU after his Supreme Court nomination was rejected by the Senate in a historic 42-34 vote. He reportedly told allies 'it's over for me,' but was persuaded to stay to avoid giving the opposition a victory.

item.title: Oposição garante que não há clima para envio de novo nome para STF antes das eleições
item.description: Following the government's defeat in the Senate, the opposition claims there is no political climate for President Lula to nominate a new Supreme Court justice before the 2026 elections, as it would likely be defeated again. Opposition senators state that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has committed to not scheduling any nomination before the election. Lula has not yet decided on a next step, though he is considering names like Rodrigo Pacheco, while advisors warn that yielding to Alcolumbre’s pressure would be perceived as a concession.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE retoma julgamento contra ex-governador de Roraima
item.description: The TSE resumed the trial that could result in the removal of Roraima's governor, Edilson Damião, for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 election. A majority of six justices have already voted for his removal and the call for new elections, awaiting only the vote of Justice André Mendonça to finalize the decision. Former governor Antonio Denarium was unanimously declared ineligible for eight years.

item.title: Ao vivo: Congresso analisa o veto de Lula ao PL da Dosimetria
item.description: Congress is set to review, starting at 10 a.m. this Thursday (April 30, 2026), President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s veto on the Dosimetry Bill, which seeks to reduce sentences for crimes such as coup d'état and criminal association. Approved by the Legislature in December 2025, the bill would benefit individuals sentenced by the STF, including former President Jair Bolsonaro, who received a 27-year and 3-month sentence for attempting a coup. The opposition claims it has the votes to override the veto, which would enact the law and potentially prompt the STF to reconsider sentences.

item.title: A rejeição de Messias e o recado político do Senado
item.description: The rejection of Jorge Rodrigo Araújo Messias's nomination to the Supreme Federal Court by the Brazilian Senate marks the first presidential defeat for a Supreme Court nominee in 132 years, reaffirming the Senate's role as a political-institutional check rather than a mere rubber stamp of the Executive. Despite approval in the Committee on Constitution and Justice, the plenary vote of 42 against and 34 in favor reflected broader political and institutional considerations beyond formal qualifications. The episode breaks with decades of automatic approvals and signals rising tensions between the branches of government.

item.title: Governo anuncia nova etapa de programa para financiar compra de caminhões e ônibus
item.description: The Lula government will announce a new phase of financing for the purchase of trucks and buses, aiming to expand credit access and strengthen support among voters historically aligned with Bolsonarism. The initiative seeks to renew vehicle fleets and stimulate productive sectors, blending economic policy with electoral strategy.

item.title: Quaest: 84% aprovam e 11% desaprovam governo de Ronaldo Caiado em Goiás
item.description: A Quaest poll released on Thursday (30) shows 84% of Goiás voters approve Ronaldo Caiado's government, with 11% disapproving and 5% undecided. Approval is highest among 16-34 year-olds (86%) and those earning above five minimum wages (90%). The survey, registered with TSE as GO-00211/2026, interviewed 1,104 people across 54 municipalities from April 24-28.

item.title: A reação das lideranças evangélicas à rejeição de Jorge Messias para o STF
item.description: Evangelical leaders celebrated the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias for the Supreme Court, calling it a 'victory for Brazil,' while the sole evangelical justice on the Court, André Mendonça, praised Messias and lamented the outcome. The 42-34 vote marked the first presidential nominee rejection in 132 years, highlighting Lula's weakened political standing ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: 51% aprovam governo de Eduardo Leite no RS, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll conducted from April 24–28, 2026 in Rio Grande do Sul shows 51% of voters approve of Governor Eduardo Leite’s (PSD) administration, while 39% disapprove and 10% are undecided. In qualitative assessment, 39% rate the government as 'regular', 34% as 'positive', and 24% as 'negative', with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Governo decidiu amplificar a crise da derrota histórica de Lula
item.description: Lula's government amplified its crisis by attempting to overturn the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination, spending billions in parliamentary amendments and promoting narratives of congressional antagonism. Despite support from some Supreme Court justices and the release of R$ 12.5 billion in amendments, Lula secured only 34 of the 41 required votes. The defeat heightens legislative risks, particularly regarding the veto on reducing sentences for the January 8 acts, which could benefit Bolsonaro.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: união inédita de PT e PDT no Rio Grande do Sul coloca esquerda na frente para governo
item.description: The unprecedented alliance between the PT and PDT in Rio Grande do Sul, with PT’s Edegar Pretto withdrawing his candidacy to become Juliana Brizola’s (PDT) running mate, has put the left ahead in the 2026 gubernatorial race, according to a Genial/Quaest poll. Brizola leads in all simulated runoffs, scoring 35-37% against Luciano Zucco (PL) at 27%, and nearly 20 points ahead of Gabriel Souza (MDB). In the first round, she technically ties Zucco at 24% to 21%, while Souza trails at 6%.

item.title: Gestão de Caiado em Goiás é aprovada por 84%, diz Quaest
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that 84% of Goiás voters approve of Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) administration as governor, with only 11% disapproving. Conducted between April 24–28, 2026 among 1,104 respondents, the survey found 69% rated his governance as 'positive', 21% as 'regular', and 5% as 'negative'. Caiado resigned the governorship to run for president in 2026.

item.title: Quaest: 51% aprovam e 39% desaprovam governo Eduardo Leite no RS
item.description: A Quaest poll shows 51% of Rio Grande do Sul voters approve of Governor Eduardo Leite's government, while 39% disapprove. The survey comes shortly after Ronaldo Caiado was named the PSD's presidential pre-candidate, prompting Leite to withdraw from the internal party race and affirm he will remain in office until the end of his term. Additionally, 47% of respondents believe the next governor should change only what is not working, while 33% advocate for a complete overhaul.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Camilo aparece à frente de Ciro no 2º turno no Ceará, em empate técnico
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Camilo Santana (PT) technically tied with Ciro Gomes (PSDB) in a potential runoff in Ceará, with 44% to 39%, within the three-point margin of error. Camilo also leads Ciro in a first-round scenario (40% to 33%) and outperforms current governor Elmano de Freitas in all evaluated scenarios. In the Senate race, Cid Gomes (PSB) and Capitão Wagner (União Brasil) are in a technical tie, both ahead of other pre-candidates.
